title: Admin looks up the data retention deal by id
userProblem: I need to check dls_008, the data retention review deal for Cedar Health. What stage is it in and what's the value?

expectedOutcome.description: Agent searches deals by exact id dls_008 and answers with the stage (negotiation) and amount (£88,000), quoting the record.

assertions.description: Agent must look the deal up rather than answer from memory.
Search must be scoped to deals with the exact id.
Answer identifies the correct deal with stage and amount.

rationale: Core lookup scenario: exact-id deal search by admin for a deal they own.
